title: PyTorch model hub HF Transformers tests fail: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0+, found 1.26.4
signature: ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found <version>|Dependencies

failed_jobs.name: PyTorch Models tests / PyTorch Models tests
failed_jobs.symptom: test_hf_transformers.py tests fail at model-load time importing datasets -> pyarrow, which rejects the installed NumPy 1.26.4

failed_jobs.name: ci/gha_overall_status
failed_jobs.symptom: Aggregate status job reports failure because an upstream job (PyTorch Models tests) failed

key_errors:
install/tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/test_hf_transformers.py:51: from datasets import Audio, load_dataset
File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/datasets/arrow_dataset.py", line 60, in <module>
  import pyarrow as pa
File "/venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pyarrow/__init__.py", line 59, in <module>
  from pyarrow.lib import (BuildInfo, CppBuildInfo, RuntimeInfo, set_timezone_db_path,
File "pyarrow/lib.pyx", line 42, in init pyarrow.lib
ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
root_cause: tests/requirements_pytorch pins numpy==1.26.4 for python_version < 3.12, and that numpy is installed first. Later, envs/hf_transformers.txt installs datasets==3.0.1, which pulls in an unpinned pyarrow>=15.0.0 (currently resolving to pyarrow-26.0.0). Modern pyarrow wheels (26.x) require NumPy >= 2.0 at import time and raise ImportError if an older NumPy is present, so any hf_transformers test that imports `datasets` (e.g., test_hf_transformers.py's load_model) fails during model loading on Python 3.11 runners where numpy 1.26.4 is pinned. This is the same failure signature recorded 4 times already since 2026-10-09T09:08, across both the 'Linux (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11)' PyTorch Models tests job and the ARM64 GatedDeltaNet transformation job, confirming the fix has not yet landed.
reproduction_steps:
1. python3.11 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
2. pip install -r tests/requirements_pytorch
3. pip install -r tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/envs/hf_transformers.txt
4. python -c "from datasets import load_dataset"  # raises ImportError: pyarrow requires NumPy 2.0 or newer, found 1.26.4
recommended_actions: Pin pyarrow explicitly in tests/model_hub_tests/pytorch/envs/hf_transformers.txt to a version compatible with NumPy 1.x (e.g., pyarrow<18 or pyarrow==17.0.0) for python_version < 3.12, since tests/requirements_pytorch intentionally pins numpy==1.26.4 on those runners.
Alternatively, cap datasets to a version whose pyarrow dependency range still supports NumPy 1.x (e.g., datasets<3.0 or datasets==3.0.1 with 'pyarrow<18' added as a direct constraint).
Add a CI smoke check that imports `datasets`/`pyarrow` right after environment setup to fail fast with a clear message instead of failing deep inside parametrized model tests.
Re-run the PyTorch Models tests job after the pin is added to confirm resolution.
prevention_strategies: Pin transitive dependencies that have strict runtime version checks (like pyarrow's NumPy floor) directly in the relevant envs/*.txt file whenever the base numpy pin diverges from what the latest transitive release expects. Consider adding a periodic dependency-drift check that resolves envs/*.txt requirement files and flags incompatible NumPy/pyarrow combinations before they land on master.
historical_context: Identical failure signature already recorded 4 times (2026-10-09T09:08:53Z, 09:22:01Z, 09:35:28Z, and in run 37901253022 at 10:14:59Z) across the 'Linux (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11)' and 'Linux ARM64 (Ubuntu 22.04, Python 3.11)' workflows, all within the last ~1.5 hours, impacting multiple commits (89f0e3a6, 344d28c8, 972aa05b). The root cause (unpinned pyarrow pulled in via datasets==3.0.1 conflicting with the deliberately pinned numpy==1.26.4) has not yet been fixed.
